📌 Worried after seeing 80+ attempts in IBPS PO Prelims reviews?
If you are seeing very high attempts on certain channels, don’t panic. I have been observing this pattern for the last 2–3 years as well.
Many students attempt 30/30 in English, but attempting ≠ scoring.
In many cases:
➡️ 12–16 questions go wrong

➡️ English score remains around 10–15 marks

➡️ Only a small number of students actually score 25+ in English
So, don’t judge your performance only by the number of attempts reported in reviews.
Accuracy + difficulty level + shift-wise performance matter much more.
Stay calm. Focus on your preparation and wait for the actual result. ❤️
Don’t let someone else’s attempts affect your confidence. 💯
— Future Banker Hub

“भारत कोकिला” के नाम से किसे जाना जाता है?

भारत के राष्ट्रगान की रचना किसने की?
